{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 (377 rows, all source_tz='UTC') was delivered with UTC timestamps, while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. Its 12:00 UTC start matches the 06:00 local start of other batches. The pipeline ignores source_tz, so the evening transactions of 01-17 spill into 01-18 at 00:00-05:00 and the date aggregates are wrong. The fix converts UTC rows to Chicago local time in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       lt.local_ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(lt.local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.local_ts AS local_ts) lt
WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
